title: Does Employer-Paid, Job-Protected Maternity Leave Help or Hurt Female
eligible_reason: Single common adoption date: PostMarch1_2017 = application submitted on/after 1 Mar 2017 for every application (confirmed in DataForMSReplication.dta: period 670-685 untreated, 686-706 treated, i.e., 2017m3 for all). Main Table 5 is a triple difference Female x Post x LowNetIncome (and Emp11_50 / ChildBearingAge variants) with applicant, company, job-post and month FE plus time-varying market-size controls (application counts by gender and role, company job counts, application type). Not staggered; additional subgroup-by-treatment interactions and time-varying controls in every column.
design_notes: Stata/MP 18 reghdfe, vce(robust). Application-level data (1.34M rows). Appendix: CEM-weighted columns, PPML, firm-size splits, person-month panel.
data_files_note: ReadMe: NDA prevents sharing all data; shipped data replicate Table 5 (main result). Other tables' code is provided without full data.
screener_notes: Screened from package only (no abstract in frame). Common-date law with DDD and controls; not staggered, not a near-miss.
title_note: Title/authors not in the frame or candidates.csv; package concerns the effect of India's 2017 maternity-benefit law on interview invitations to female applicants on an e-recruitment platform. package_manifest lists year 2025.
